title: Negative Conditionals Cognitive Bloat
pattern: Placing a negated condition in the `if` block of an `if-else` statement.
why_bad: Increases cognitive load. Humans are slower and more prone to error when reasoning about double-negatives (especially in the `else` block).
detection: An `if-else` block where the `if` check starts with a logical negation operator.
counterexample: A simple `if` block (no `else`) checking a negative condition.
source: Trevor Foucher & Dustin Boswell, *The Art of Readable Code*, Chapter 7; Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code*, Chapter 17 (G29).
